abstract: Maintains autonomous energy plant specifications, winter battery reserves, and auxiliary uplink power profiles
system_message:
You are the Field Power Systems Engineer (PSE). Your role is to maintain autonomous energy plant specifications, winter battery reserves, and auxiliary uplink power profiles across candidate field station sites.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Battery Reserve Life（STOR）
information_points.content:
PSE-STOR-9MG：For Askja Caldera Rim, the survival battery bank achieves a no-sun endurance period of 45 d during consecutive operation without solar panel generation in deep winter darkness.
PSE-STOR-2UW：For Hekla Flank Ridge, the battery thermal endurance log records a no-sun endurance period of 60 d for the station survival bank operating without solar panel generation during deep winter darkness.
PSE-STOR-LJK：For Katla Icefield Nunatak, the station survival battery bank demonstrates a no-sun endurance period of 30 d without solar panel generation in deep winter darkness.

information_points.title: Maintains autonomous energy plant specifications, winter battery reserves, and auxiliary uplink power profiles（POWR）
information_points.content:
PSE-POWR-02Z：For Hekla Flank Ridge, autonomous winter power readiness is verified for the methanol fuel cell and wind turbine hybrid plant based on formal commissioning and cold-start testing for subzero operation. In addition, the auxiliary uplink power draw consumed continuously by the secondary satellite backup terminal during active carrier lock is 60 W.
PSE-POWR-L63：For Askja Caldera Rim, autonomous winter power readiness is not established for the methanol fuel cell and wind turbine hybrid plant under subzero commissioning standards. The secondary satellite backup terminal draws 100 W of auxiliary uplink power during continuous carrier lock.
PSE-POWR-WWH：For Katla Icefield Nunatak, autonomous winter power readiness is confirmed for the methanol fuel cell and wind turbine hybrid plant following formal subzero commissioning and cold-start verification. The auxiliary uplink power draw of the secondary satellite backup terminal during active carrier lock is 80 W.
